summary.text: Use the Monthly payout estimator to estimate the Retirement Account savings you need.

steps.name: Use the estimator
steps.text: Use the Monthly payout estimator to estimate how much Retirement Account savings you need. It uses your desired monthly payout and choice of payout start age.

items: The Monthly payout estimator estimates the Retirement Account savings you need.
